retryInterval.description: ms between retry attempts — default 400, clamped 50..5000. Applies to transient failures only (TargetNotFound, Stale, assert mismatch); Malformed/AmbiguousTarget/PolicyDenied/EmergencyStopped never retry

app.description: launch: friendly app name resolved via Windows app registration ("Spotify", "Notepad", "Calculator")

search.description: launch: search installed apps and open best match — alias of app

uri.description: launch: URI with a registered protocol handler ("spotify:")

arguments.description: launch: structured arguments — each element one verbatim argument; never a command line

newInstance.description: launch: force a new instance instead of reusing a running window — default false

waitFor.description: launch readiness: window (default — usable top-level window+UIA) | process | none

debugPort.description: launch: optional remote debugging port for Chrome DevTools Protocol / CDP (e.g. 9222)

where.description: scan/for_each: filter criteria for matching items (startsWith, contains, role, etc.)

startsWith.description: item name must start with this (case-insensitive)

contains.description: item name or value must contain this

notContains.description: item name or value must NOT contain this

exact.description: item name or value must exactly equal this

state.description: item state must contain this (e.g. checked, focused)

steps.description: scan/for_each: sub-steps executed for each matching item (binds $item or $as)

maxItems.description: scan/for_each: maximum items to process (default 20, max 200)

maxPages.description: scan/for_each: maximum pages/scrolls to paginate for virtualized lists (default 0)

collect.description: scan/for_each: properties to collect from matching items, e.g. ["name", "value", "id"]

minCount.description: wait_for: minimum number of matching elements

stopOnDialog.description: wait_for: stop immediately if an unexpected modal dialog appears (default true)

autoScroll.description: auto-heal offscreen elements: scroll container or invoke native ScrollIntoView when element is offscreen (default true)

autoNavigate.description: auto-navigate across known screens if target is detected on another screen via screen memory (default false)

observe.description: piggyback scoped observation after this step executes (zero-turn feedback)

continueOnError.description: record this step's failure and keep executing the rest of the plan instead of pausing (batch continueOnError / failFast:false); EmergencyStopped/Cancelled still stop the run

silent.description: deliver input via background window messages instead of foreground SendInput — no focus theft, works on unfocused/occluded windows; applies to click/invoke/toggle/type/set_value/close steps — unsupported kinds return NotSupported, never a silent SendInput fallback

runId.description: resume an existing run — keeps its element bindings

detail.description: output verbosity: slim|full — default from INBRISK_DETAIL or settings.json outputDetail

saveAsRecipe.description: on success, generalize the executed steps and persist as task-recipes/<name>.json — replay later via computer_run_recipe

enableReflex.description: intercept unexpected modal dialogs between steps via the reflex engine (default true)

autoDismissModals.description: auto-dismiss policy for save-confirmation modals: off|save|discard|closeOnly (default closeOnly — cancels the prompt rather than committing or discarding work)

operationId.description: optional client operation ID for safe transport retry deduplication

hwnd.description: window handle to inspect (hex or decimal); default = active

detail.description: output verbosity: slim|full — default from INBRISK_DETAIL or settings.json outputDetail

relational.description: group rows/items relationally with their child actions and labels — ideal for lists/tables

hwnds.description: batch list of window handles to inspect in one call (max 16)
